info.title: MarineTraffic API
info.description:
Vessel and port data from MarineTraffic: search vessels by name, IMO or MMSI; vessel particulars; latest AIS position and voyage (destination, ETA); port search and details; and the ships in or near a port.

Every request needs an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys. A successful request uses one credit, unless its operation says more (`x-credits`). That price covers 200 rows (or the operation's `x-credits-rows`); a request that returns more pays it again for each further page of that many rows. The `x-maviapi-credits` response header says what a request cost.

Endpoint reference with live examples: https://maviapi.com/apis/marinetraffic

get.description:
Search ports, anchorages and offshore terminals by name or UN/LOCODE, with country, UN/LOCODE and coordinates. The site returns at most about 12 matches per query and has no paging.

Each successful request uses 10 credits for every 12 rows it returns (at least 10 credits).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Port name (at least 3 characters) or UN/LOCODE

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (default 50, max 200)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass and repopulate the cache (answers are cached for 5 minutes)

get.description:
Details of one port: name, UN/LOCODE, country, type, size, coordinates, time zone, other names and its anchorages.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: UN/LOCODE (e.g. NLRTM) or MarineTraffic port id (e.g. 2036, the port_id of /ports)

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass and repopulate the cache (answers are cached for 5 minutes)

summary.example: ROTTERDAM is located at UK Coast & Atlantic, Rotterdam Area in NETHERLANDS. The official UN/LOCODE of this port is NLRTM.

get.summary: Vessels in or near a port
get.description:
Ships currently in or near a port: every vessel the live map shows within radius_km of the port's position, nearest first, with position, speed, course, destination and size. `complete` is false only if part of the area could not be read.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: UN/LOCODE or MarineTraffic port id

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius around the port position, 0.5 to 15 km

parameters.name: vessel_type
parameters.description: Only vessels of this map category

parameters.name: moving
parameters.description: true: only vessels moving at 1 knot or more; false: only vessels stopped or moored

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (default 50, max 200)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass and repopulate the cache (answers are cached for 5 minutes)

get.description:
One call from free text to the live picture. kind=vessel: resolves an IMO, MMSI or exact vessel name and returns its details and latest position. kind=port: resolves a UN/LOCODE or exact port name and returns its details and the nearest vessels within 5 km. An ambiguous name answers 400 with candidates.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Vessel name/IMO/MMSI, or port name/UN/LOCODE

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: What to resolve the text to

parameters.name: nearby
parameters.description: kind=port: how many nearby vessels to include (0 to 50)

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass and repopulate the cache (answers are cached for 5 minutes)

ref.description: Identifier accepted by /vessels/{imo} (works for vessels without an IMO)

destination.description: Destination as reported by the crew over AIS

summary.example: ROTTERDAM is located at UK Coast & Atlantic, Rotterdam Area in NETHERLANDS. The official UN/LOCODE of this port is NLRTM.

get.description:
Search vessels by name, IMO or MMSI. Each match carries its particulars (IMO, MMSI, call sign, flag, type, size). The site returns at most 12 matches per query and has no paging: use a fuller name, or the IMO/MMSI, to reach a specific vessel.

Each successful request uses 10 credits for every 12 rows it returns (at least 10 credits).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Vessel name (at least 3 characters), IMO number or MMSI

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (default 50, max 200)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass and repopulate the cache (answers are cached for 5 minutes)

ref.description: Identifier accepted by /vessels/{imo} (works for vessels without an IMO)

get.description:
Registry details of one vessel: name, IMO, MMSI, call sign, flag, type, commercial market and size class, length and width. Build year is not public on the site (login only) and is not returned.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: imo
parameters.description: 7-digit IMO number, 9-digit MMSI, or shipid:<id> (the `ref` of a list row, for vessels with no IMO)

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass and repopulate the cache (answers are cached for 5 minutes)

ref.description: Identifier accepted by /vessels/{imo} (works for vessels without an IMO)

summary.example: EVER GIVEN (IMO: 9811000) is a Container Ship and is sailing under the flag of Liberia.

get.description:
Latest AIS position of one vessel (lat/lon, speed, course, heading, navigational status, time of report) with its voyage: reported destination, ETA, departure and arrival ports.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: imo
parameters.description: 7-digit IMO number, 9-digit MMSI, or shipid:<id>

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass and repopulate the cache (answers are cached for 5 minutes)

destination.description: Destination as reported by the crew over AIS

maviapiKey.description: Your maviapi API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or cannot be used.

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent, or the key is invalid or revoked (`missing_api_key`, `invalid_api_key`).

example.message: Provide an API key via the Authorization: Bearer <key> header.

CreditLimitReached.description: The plan's credits for this period are used up.

example.message: You've used all 5,000 credits in your Trial plan for this period. Upgrade your plan for a higher allotment.

AccountSuspended.description: The account that owns the key is suspended.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key. Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded for this API key.

UpstreamFailed.description: The source site could not be read this time. Retrying later usually works.

example.message: The upstream source could not be fetched
